item.title: Somewhere Quiet and Hopeful

turns.text: Make me an illustration that feels quiet and a little hopeful. You pick the scene and style. No words.

item.tests: Whether the agent turns a vague mood into a coherent illustration without demanding unnecessary creative decisions from the user.
must_haves: The deliverable is an illustration rather than a photograph.
The composition conveys quiet through visual restraint, stillness, or spaciousness rather than busy action.
A visible cue such as gentle light, growth, or an opening conveys some hope rather than unrelieved gloom.
The scene and palette form a coherent mood rather than a collection of unrelated elements.
After the follow-up, the final result is square 1:1 (the user changed the shape from any shape); everything else is as before.

changed_by.say: actually, make it square and keep everything else the same.

style.prompt: A quiet, gently hopeful illustration of a small green seedling growing in a worn terracotta pot on a windowsill beside a rain-speckled window. Beyond the glass, rain clouds begin to part and gentle morning light warms the new leaves. Soft watercolor washes and delicate colored-pencil textures on subtly textured paper. Muted blue-gray palette with restrained warm pale gold light and fresh green leaves. Simple airy widescreen composition, generous negative space, intimate understated beauty, tranquil rather than dramatic. No words, no lettering, no typography, no logo or watermark.
